docs.summary: Drives a lightmap bake for the open scene with Prowl.Photonic: gathers lightmap-static renderers + lights + probes, runs the CPU baker on its background thread, then (on the main thread) writes the atlas pages as RGBM PNGs into a SceneName_lightmaps folder, assigns per-renderer lightmap index/scale-offset, bakes + tetrahedralizes light probes, and saves the scene.

The scene the in-flight bake belongs to, or null when idle. Only one bake can run at a time; callers showing bake UI for a scene should compare this against their own scene rather than trusting [`IsBaking`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Lightmapping.LightmapBakeService~IsBaking) alone, which is true for any scene while baking.

docs.summary: Begin a bake of `scene`. Returns false (with a logged reason) if there's nothing to bake.
Call once per editor frame while [`IsBaking`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Lightmapping.LightmapBakeService~IsBaking). Finalizes when the target iterations are reached.
Cancels the current bake, if any, and resets the service to idle.
Returns true if the scene currently has any baked lightmap pages or probes to clear.
Remove all baked lighting from the scene: delete the SceneName_lightmaps folder, clear the scene's baked data + probes, and reset every renderer's lightmap index. Saves the scene.
